name: Other Amounts 29
definition: Identifies other amounts pertaining to the transaction.

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Interest amount that has accrued in between coupon payment periods.

ChargesFees.name: Charges Fees
ChargesFees.definition: Amount of money paid for the provision of financial services that cannot be categorised by another qualifier.

CountryNationalFederalTax.name: Country National Federal Tax
CountryNationalFederalTax.definition: Amount of country, national or federal tax charged by the jurisdiction in which the account servicer is located.

LocalTax.name: Local Tax
LocalTax.definition: Tax charged by the jurisdiction in which the financial instrument settles.

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: An amount that is not indicated by a known business denomination.

RegulatoryAmount.name: Regulatory Amount
RegulatoryAmount.definition: Amount of money charged by a regulatory authority, for example, Securities and Exchange fees.

ShippingAmount.name: Shipping Amount
ShippingAmount.definition: All costs related to the physical delivery of documents such as stamps, postage, carrier fees, insurances or messenger services.

TransferTax.name: Transfer Tax
TransferTax.definition: Amount of tax levied on a transfer of ownership of financial instrument.

WithholdingTax.name: Withholding Tax
WithholdingTax.definition: Amount of money that will be withheld by a tax authority.

AccruedCapitalisationAmount.name: Accrued Capitalisation Amount
AccruedCapitalisationAmount.definition: Amount of unpaid interest (on bonds which have defaulted and have subsequently |restructured), which is capitalized and added to the original principal amount of the bond.
